sources.snippet: Model Overview parakeet-tdt_ctc-110m is an ASR model that transcribes speech with Punctuations and Capitalizations of the English alphabet. This model is jointly developed by NVIDIA NeMo and Suno.ai teams. It is a Large version of Hybrid FastConformer [1] TDT-CTC [2] (around 114M parameters) model.
